purpose: independent sympy verification of the Lovelock tensors P_(k)^h_j, A_(k)^lh (k = 1, 2, 3) and the curvature computed by Revision/gkd_lovelock/code (Rust, GKD); shares no code with the Rust crate

conventions.riemann: MTW: R^a_bcd = d_c Gamma^a_bd - d_d Gamma^a_bc + Gamma^a_ce Gamma^e_bd - Gamma^a_de Gamma^e_bc; R^ab_cd = g^be R^a_ecd; R^h_j = R^ha_ja; G = Ric - R/2
conventions.kdelta: Det[Outer[delta, lower, upper]] with sympy Matrix.det, memoised by the 0/1 matrix
conventions.lovelock: P_(k)^h_j = kdelta[{j,j1..j2k},{h,h1..h2k}] R^{j1j2}_{h1h2}...; L_(k) = kdelta[{j1..},{h1..}] R...R; A_(k)^lh = sqrt|g| g^jl P_(k)^h_j
conventions.sqrtAbsDetG: cos(6 H x8) (det g = cos^2(6 H x8); domain 0 < 6 H x8 < pi/2)
